title: Visibility contract and missing ingress metrics uncovered by capacity regression
creator: Asha Patel
description: Summary: During a capacity regression on 2026-03-02 a subset of console routes experienced unexplained latency and throttling. Post-incident review showed the root cause was not the runtime scheduler but an instrumentation and visibility gap: several ingress accounting counters and per-route queue-depth metrics were not emitted for the new proxy path introduced in runtime-1.18. This prevented autoscale and alerting from triggering and obscured the early signs of saturation. The ticket creates an explicit visibility contract for any new ingress path and implements missing metrics/dashboards + CI checks.
actions: Add route-level ingress counters for: requests_total, active_requests, queue_depth, and backend_errors for the new proxy path (PR: gh/redwood/runtime#8762)
Instrument KV-cache eviction and prefix-hit ratios with per-tenant tagging so Console dashboards can correlate tail latency to cache pressure
Create a visibility contract document that lists required telemetry for any new networking/proxy change and add it to PR checklist
Add synthetic ingress traffic smoke test that asserts ingress counters advance and alerts fire under simulated saturation
Update Console Dashboards: create 'Per-route queue depth' panel and a 'Route-level SLI delta' heatmap to surface divergence from baseline
Add CI telemetry contract test that fails a PR if any required metric for a new route is missing in e2e staging run
Adjust alerting: lower warning threshold for per-route queue_depth where tenant weight > 1% and add an automatic runbook link
Schedule follow-up audit across all runtime branches to detect other unaccounted ingress paths
comments: 2026-03-05 - Asha Patel: Initial triage complete. No config drift found in autoscaler. Tracing shows requests stuck in proxy handoff. Opening this ticket to track missing metrics and dashboards.
2026-03-06 - Miguel Vargas: Reproduced on staging by enabling the proxy path feature flag. Confirmed metrics were not created due to path sanitizer filtering out '/proxy/v2' tags.
2026-03-07 - Design review (Tamara Lee): Dashboard mockups attached, recommended a heatmap and a small multiples view for high-cardinality tenants.
2026-03-09 - Infra (Omar Khan): PR to runtime adding counters is ready for review: gh/redwood/runtime/pull/8762. Need an owner for the CI contract test.
2026-03-11 - Miguel Vargas: Began CI contract test implementation. Blocked by flaky staging metrics ingestion; filed ENG-70601 to harden the staging ingestion pipeline.
2026-03-12 - PM (Sofia Nguyen): Confirmed customer tickets referencing latency spikes (CS-3344). Prioritize metric rollout for highest-traffic routes first.

2026-03-13 - Miguel Vargas: Dashboard panels created in Grafana sandbox: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ingress/route-visibility (sandbox). Linking to PRs in description. Planning rollout to prod dashboards behind a feature flag.
acceptance_criteria: Per-route ingress counters exist in prod for the new proxy path and pass e2e smoke tests
Per-route queue_depth and active_requests panels are visible in Console for owners and match staging baselines
CI telemetry contract test runs on every PR touching ingress code and fails when required metrics are missing
Runbook updated with clear remediation steps and playbook for throttling caused by uninstrumented paths
Customer tickets linked to this regression show no recurrence after rollout for two weeks
progress_summary: Instrumentation PR merged to staging; dashboards validated in sandbox. CI contract tests in progress but blocked by staging ingestion flakiness (ENG-70601). Planning phased rollout: 1) merge instrumentation, 2) enable dashboards in prod behind flag, 3) turn on CI checks after staging stability.
